factor_name: Upper-quartile US10Y rate-shock conditioned residual reversal

calculation.description: During an upper-quartile trailing 252-day five-day US10Y log-rate shock, rank assets by negative three-day return residual to the cross-sectional median; otherwise signal is unavailable/zero. All inputs are lagged completed daily data.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across 2020-2022 (0.037710), 2023-2024 (0.018508), and 2025-2026 (0.088705); no active 2027 YTD observations in capped sample. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.

provenance.method: daily cross-sectional Spearman correlation; forward close-to-close returns; no look-ahead
